name: Virag Tripathi
title: Principal, AI Ecosystems Engineer
summary: Customer-facing technical leader spanning sales engineering, field engineering, and applied AI. Takes customer and partner problems from discovery through proofs of concept to production, combining solution architecture with hands-on development. Previously a Principal Field Engineer at Redis and Principal Solutions Architect at Cockroach Labs.

bullets: Turned developer needs and customer feedback into CockroachDB plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and Codex. Delivered the ChatGPT marketplace launch and worked with Cloud engineering on required MCP capabilities.
Built CockroachDB’s Debezium source connector and JDBC sink support. The connector was adopted upstream and graduated from incubating; source and sink were published on Confluent Hub.
Designed, wrote, and maintain langchain-cockroachdb: vector and hybrid search, chat history, LangGraph checkpoints, and long-term memory. Authored the CockroachDB provider documentation.
Wrote the CockroachDB integration for Google’s MCP Toolbox for Databases and collaborated with Google to merge it upstream.
Built the native CockroachDB connector for PeerDB to stream changes into ClickHouse. Validated a full CDC mirror on a five-node cluster with node failures; counts and checksums matched.
Shipped CockroachDB certification on IBM Power Systems and IBM Cloud. Contributed core platform fixes, including the ppc64le page-size fix released in v26.3.

Led technical engagements across core banking, CDC, and AI partnerships, working through proofs of concept and database blockers with partner engineers. Built a CockroachDB-to-watsonx.data and Apache Iceberg pipeline.
Led technical enablement for IBM LinuxONE and Power, from initial validation through platform support, providing groundwork for the IBM OEM agreement announced in October 2025.
Originated the enriched changefeed envelope request in 2024 and worked with product on its delivery in v25.2, enabling third-party CDC integrations using Debezium-format changefeeds.
Built Banko AI, a multi-agent banking assistant running RAG and memory on CockroachDB, packaged for PyPI and Docker. Presented the resilient agentic AI work at AWS re:Invent 2025.
Built Redis Connect, a CDC and data integration platform for Redis Enterprise used in production at Fortune 100 customers in consumer technology, telecom, and financial services.
Owned data integration and messaging in the field, building customer-facing proofs of concept and demos. Built the Redis Enterprise Docker Extension for local development and testing.

Reached 160% of ARR goal in 2020 and 110% in 2018, with the most net-new logos in the Americas. Architected Redis solutions, built proofs of concept, and guided customer HA and disaster recovery strategies across clouds.
